summary: Immersion Corp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting receipt of a Nasdaq Staff letter confirming the company has regained compliance with Listing Rule 5250(c)(1), closing the matter. No transaction, tender offer, or special situation is involved; it is a routine compliance update. The filing serves as notice of regulatory compliance resolution and carries no deal terms, recommendations, or structural mechanics. The event is purely administrative and does not trigger any risk-arb or special situation analysis.
